title: ParGroup Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for parameter groups, covering tuple-valued parameter state, bind/export metadata, default modes, enable expressions, group-level value/expression access, copy/destroy behavior, and multi-component parameter handling.
guidance: Use this article when generated Python needs to work with a tuple-style parameter group such as translate, color, or size.
Many ParGroup members are tuple-valued, so generated code should provide one value per component instead of a scalar when setting expressions or defaults.
bindExpr is a tuple of expressions and should be quoted as expressions, not passed as live objects.
Group enable affects all individual parameters in the group, while enableExpr is shared by the group and its parameters.
Destroying a sequential ParGroup destroys the whole sequence block; re-fetch parameter references after destructive operations.
